supporting_helpers.behavior: Passive addInitScript wrapper observes actual FormData File name/text and pathname. Calls originalFetch.apply(this, arguments) and returns its unchanged native return; does not modify options/body or replace application API serialization. observedImportFile reads completed observations for the same request path.
supporting_helpers.limitation: Observation certifies the actual browser File sent to native fetch, not backend receipt. WebKit intercepted multipart omits file bytes; Chromium/Firefox retain raw multipart assertions.

applied_unit_loader_proof.actual_behavior: compiledModule reads ../src/${filename} as UTF-8 at execution, transpiles that source with TypeScript, rewrites API/workspace import bindings to doubles, recursively compiles current ui/member-import/audit-time/member-presentation modules, then imports the generated data URL. importUi loads current member-import.ts; no copied controller implementation or prebuilt JS is used.
applied_unit_loader_proof.scoped_assertions: Current-source member CSV controller retains review on filtering, requires call approval, uses selected member, exact confirm_call_changes and reviewed-hash on apply, calls refresh once, displays the newly applied honest confirmed/saved-result copy, and removes Apply after success. Root updated only the obsolete old success-copy expectation.
applied_unit_loader_proof.limitations: The retained114-pass log has no embedded source-hash manifest. Current source hashes are recorded at mapping; loader provenance is source-inspected, not a fabricated historical log hash binding. API doubles and lightweight hosts do not certify browser rendering or backend behavior.

historical_diagnostics.interpretation: Preobserver WebKit capture failure did not prove product file loss. Fresh78 workflows use held passive observation and explicit evidence limits.
